BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. That Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the B1-3 Neighborhood Shopping District
symbols as shown on Map Number 10-I in the area generally bounded by:

South Sacramento Avenue; a line 306.46 feet north of the intersection of South
Sacramento Avenue and South Archer Avenue as measured along the east right of
way line of South Sacramento Avenue and perpendicular thereto, a line 120.20
feet east of and parallel to South Sacramento Avenue; a line 296.46 feet north of
the intersection of South Sacramento Avenue and South Archer Avenue as
measured along the east right of way line of South Sacramento Avenue and
perpendicular thereto; the alley next east of and parallel to South Sacramento
Avenue and extended where no alley exists; a line 128 feet northwest of and
parallel to South Archer Avenue; a line 255.54 feet northeast of the intersection of
South Sacramento Avenue and South Archer Avenue as measured along the north
right of way line of South Archer Avenue and perpendicular thereto; and South
Archer Avenue,

to those of a B1-3 Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and due publication.

Common Address:
4172-92 S. Archer Avenue
